title: Pharmacy (Responsible Pharmacists, Superintendent Pharmacists etc.) Order 2022
amendmentMotionNotes: Lord Hunt of King's Heath moved, as an amendment to the motion to approve the draft Order, at the end insert “but that this House regrets that the Order does not make provision about the wider workforce challenges facing the community pharmacy sector”. The House divided:
